title: Summer of the Sea Serpent
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: On the summer solstice, Jack and Annie turn into seals to find Excalibur and face a giant sea serpent! 🌊🐉

q.en: On what day does Merlin send Jack and Annie on this mission?
q.zh: 梅林在这一天派杰克和安妮去执行任务？

options.en: The summer solstice, the first day of summer
The winter solstice, the coldest and shortest day
options.zh: 冬至，最冷也最短的一天

explain.en: The mission begins on the summer solstice, the first day of summer and the day with the most daylight. Merlin chose this day because the Ice Wizard of Winter's powers are weakest then.
explain.zh: 任务从夏至开始——那是夏天的第一天，也是白昼最长的一天。梅林选这一天，是因为冬之冰巫师的力量在此时最弱。

q.en: What is the 'Sword of Light' really called?

options.zh: 命运之钻，在很远很远的地方，不过那是另一个故事了

explain.en: Merlin tells Jack and Annie that this sword is even more powerful than the sword in the stone, and that it has a name—Excalibur. He will return it to the Lady of the Lake on the Isle of Avalon.
explain.zh: 梅林告诉杰克和安妮，这把剑比石中剑还要强大，它有一个名字——Excalibur（王者之剑）。他要把它送回阿瓦隆岛的湖中仙女那里。

q.en: Who is the mysterious Water Knight who carries them across the cove?
q.zh: 那位驮着他们穿过小海湾的神秘“水骑士”是谁？

options.en: A talking seagull, though that is another story

explain.en: At the end, Jack notices that Merlin's farewell wave—spreading his fingers—is the same gesture the Water Knight gave them. The Water Knight was Merlin in disguise, helping them get started.
explain.zh: 故事结尾，杰克发现梅林道别时张开手指挥手的姿势，和水骑士告别时一模一样。那位水骑士正是梅林假扮的，是为了帮他们开启任务。

q.en: How does the giant Spider Queen (Morag) help Jack and Annie?
q.zh: 巨大的蜘蛛女王（莫拉格）是怎样帮助杰克和安妮的？

options.en: She hisses and scares them out of the cave
options.zh: 她嘶嘶叫着把他们吓出山洞

options.en: She carries them off on her hairy back
options.zh: 她把他们驮在毛茸茸的背上带走

options.en: She wraps them tightly in a big sticky web forever
options.zh: 她把他们紧紧裹在一张大黏网里再也不放

options.en: She spins a web ladder so they can climb to safety
options.zh: 她织出一张网梯，让他们爬到安全处

explain.en: As the tide floods the cave, the Spider Queen spins a sticky web ladder between two strands and whispers 'Climb! Climb! Climb!' She wanted to help them escape, not trap them.
explain.zh: 海水涨潮灌进山洞时，蜘蛛女王在两根蛛丝之间织出一张黏糊糊的网梯，轻声催促“爬！爬！爬！”她想帮他们逃脱，而不是困住他们。

q.en: What are selkies, like their friend Kathleen?
q.zh: 像他们的朋友凯瑟琳那样的“海豹人（selkie）”是什么？

options.en: Seal people: human on land, seal in the sea
options.zh: 海豹人：在陆地上是人，在海里是海豹

options.en: Strange pale water horses with long fish tails and manes
options.zh: 长着长长鱼尾和鬃毛的奇怪苍白水马，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: Teddy explains that selkies are people on land and seals in the sea. When Kathleen dries off in the sun, her seal skin falls away and she becomes human; she lends Jack and Annie seal skins so they can swim as seals.
explain.zh: 泰迪解释说，海豹人在陆地上是人，在海里是海豹。凯瑟琳在太阳下晒干身体时，海豹皮就会脱落，变回人形；她借给杰克和安妮海豹皮，让他们也能变成海豹游泳。

q.en: What is the 'Cloak of the Old Gray Ghost' in the story?
q.zh: 故事里的“老灰鬼的斗篷”其实是什么？

explain.en: Kathleen says the 'Cloak of the Old Gray Ghost' is just what selkies call a very thick fog. Merlin later reveals that the Ice Wizard sent this fog to cover them.
explain.zh: 凯瑟琳说，“老灰鬼的斗篷”不过是海豹人对一场浓雾的称呼。梅林后来揭开，这团雾正是冬之冰巫师放出来笼罩他们的。

q.en: What is the 'Ancient Question' the sea serpent asks them?
q.zh: 海蛇问他们的那个“古老问题”是什么？

options.en: What is the purpose of the sword?
Where in the world did the sword come from?
options.zh: 这把剑究竟是从哪里来的？

explain.en: The sea serpent coils around their rock and booms the Ancient Question: 'WHAT IS THE PURPOSE OF THE SWORD?' Only by answering wisely can they prove themselves worthy.
explain.zh: 海蛇盘绕在礁石周围，大声提出那个古老问题：“这把剑的用途是什么？”只有明智地回答，才能证明他们配得上这把剑。

q.en: What answer proves Jack and Annie worthy of the sword?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮给出了什么答案，证明他们配得上这把剑？

options.en: To make it always cold winter
options.zh: 让寒冷的冬天永驻，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: To bring peace, not to harm

explain.en: Remembering Merlin's line 'Answer a question with love, not fear,' Jack declares the sword's purpose is peace—it should not harm anyone, and it should help take away fear so people stop fighting. The serpent accepts this answer.
explain.zh: 杰克想起梅林那句“用爱而非恐惧来回答问题”，于是说出剑的用途是和平——它不应伤害任何人，而应消除恐惧、让人们停止争斗。海蛇认可了这个答案。

q.en: How do Jack and Annie get back to the sea cliff with the sword?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮是怎样带着剑回到海崖上的？

options.en: Teddy's rhyme makes a glowing bridge of light
options.zh: 泰迪的咒语造出一座发光的光之桥

options.en: They pull on their seal skins and swim back to shore
options.zh: 他们套上海豹皮，游回岸边

options.en: The giant sea serpent offers to carry them on its back
options.zh: 巨大的海蛇主动把他们驮在背上，发生在很久很久以前

options.en: Merlin appears and magically flies them home
options.zh: 梅林出现，用魔法载他们飞回家

explain.en: Teddy shouts 'O Sword of Light, now light the night!' and Kathleen finishes the selkie rhyme, making the sword's beams form a glittering bridge of light from the island to the cliff. Jack and Annie walk across it.
explain.zh: 泰迪高喊“哦，光之剑，照亮今夜吧！”，凯瑟琳用海豹人的语言补全咒语，剑光交织成一座闪闪发光的光之桥，从礁岛一直延伸到海崖。杰克和安妮从桥上走了回去。

q.en: Who truly owns the Sword of Light that they recover?
q.zh: 他们找到的“光之剑”真正的主人到底是谁？

options.en: The Ice Wizard of Winter, who buried it deep underground
options.zh: 把它深深埋在地下的冬之冰巫师，在很远很远的地方

options.en: The Lady of the Lake, whom the serpent serves
options.zh: 湖中仙女，海蛇正是为她守护宝剑

explain.en: The Ice Wizard stole the sword from the Lady of the Lake and buried it, but it was useless to him because of her spell. The sea serpent serves the Lady of the Lake and guarded the sword. Merlin returns Excalibur to her on the Isle of Avalon.
explain.zh: 冬之冰巫师从湖中仙女那里偷走宝剑并把它埋下，但因仙女的咒语，剑对他毫无用处。海蛇效忠湖中仙女，一直守护着这把剑。梅林要把 Excalibur 送回阿瓦隆岛的湖中仙女手中。
